title: Oracle Midday Brief

# ORACLE MIDDAY BRIEF

Bitcoin holding steady at 78,385—essentially flat over 24 hours. That's your first signal: consolidation in a fear-dominated market. Fear & Greed at 39 tells us sentiment's compressed, which historically precedes volatility.

Network health remains robust. Hashrate pushing 1066.9 exahash—miners aren't panicking despite margin pressure. That's bullish conviction underneath the surface.

Mempool's relatively clean at 55K transactions with 5 sat/vB base fees. No congestion st
